text: I give no trade instructions or sizing; that decision stays with you, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. Fact: the LME copper spread net of interest is 2.037% (98th percentile since 2014, s46/s47), 1.73 pp above the 0.308% that visible stocks imply (s53/s54). Inference: the curve is tighter than stocks explain, but this storage relationship is contemporaneous and untested as a signal, so it is not a forecast.
